def house_bowling(rolls: list[int]) -> int:
    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    for frame in range(10):
        if frame < 9:  # Frames 1-9
            if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
                score += 10 + rolls[roll_idx + 1] + rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 1
            elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
                score += 10 + rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 2
            else:  # Open frame
                score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Frame 10 - no bonus rolls
            # Just add all remaining rolls in frame 10
            if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike in frame 10
                score += rolls[roll_idx]
                roll_idx += 1
            else:  # Not a strike in frame 10
                score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                roll_idx += 2
    
    return score

    score = 0
    roll_idx = 0
    
    for frame in range(10):
        if frame < 9:  # Frames 1-9
            if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike
                score += 10
                # Add bonus: next two rolls if they exist
                if roll_idx + 1 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 1
            elif rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1] == 10:  # Spare
                score += 10
                # Add bonus: next roll if it exists
                if roll_idx + 2 < len(rolls):
                    score += rolls[roll_idx + 2]
                roll_idx += 2
            else:  # Open frame
                score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                roll_idx += 2
        else:  # Frame 10 - no bonus rolls
            # Just add all remaining rolls in frame 10
            if rolls[roll_idx] == 10:  # Strike in frame 10
                score += rolls[roll_idx]
                roll_idx += 1
            else:  # Not a strike in frame 10
                score += rolls[roll_idx] + rolls[roll_idx + 1]
                roll_idx += 2
    
    return score
